title: StarRocks acl: SQL-driven RBAC -- least-priv app role
description: The nexus-cli acl verb for StarRocks: SQL-driven RBAC. Verifies the app user + app_rw role exist, the app user CAN SELECT/INSERT on nexus.* but CANNOT DROP, and the root password gate is in effect.

observe.what: app has DEFAULT ROLE app_rw (SELECT,INSERT on nexus.*) -- least privilege

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.31 "mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P 9030 -u app -p$SR_APP_PW -N -e 'SELECT count(*) FROM nexus.events'"

observe.what: the app user CAN SELECT (returns a count) -- app_rw grants read

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.31 "mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P 9030 -u app -p$SR_APP_PW -e 'DROP TABLE nexus.events' 2>&1 || echo DENIED_AS_EXPECTED"

observe.what: Access denied -> DENIED_AS_EXPECTED -- the least-priv app role cannot DROP (no DROP grant)

whatProves: RBAC is SQL-driven + enforced: app holds exactly SELECT,INSERT on nexus.* and is denied DDL/DROP; root is password-gated. The acl verb manages this surface.
